section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.9) describes the media consumption measurement procedures used in the study. Participants reported hours spent watching television daily, reading magazines monthly, and using the Internet during weekdays and weekends on an 8-point scale (0 to 6+ hours). Magazine consumption was further assessed by type (fashion, health/fitness, sports, men's interest, gay), with item scores averaged for each media form to create composite consumption measures.
